title: Get a TikTok in-app link
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the corresponding TikTok in-app link for an open TikTok URL. The in-app link you get can be passed to the `deeplink` field when creating or updating a Reach & Frequency ad. > **Note**
TikTok In-app links is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/tools/open_url/|/v1.3/tool/open_url/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/open_url/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {required}|string| Advertiser ID | |url {required}|string| Open URL that you want to get the internal link for. | |url_type {required}| string| Type of the open TikTok URL. Enum:
  • `USER_PROFILE`
  • `VIDEO`: Video detail page
  • `HASHTAG_CHALLENGE`: Hashtag challenge page
  • `MUSIC`: Music page
  • `STICKER`: Sticker (special effect) page
  • `STICKER_SHOOTER`: Shoot a video with a sticker (special effect).
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code CURL CURL) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tool/open_url/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&url={{url}}&url_type=USER_PROFILE' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|The return code. For the complete list of error codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|The return message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| |data |object|Returned data| #|open_url|string| TikTok internal link.| #|supported_regions|string[]| Countries and/or regions that the sticker (special effect) can be used. Returned when `url_type` is `STICKER` or `STICKER_SHOOTER`. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code JSON JSON) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "2021090212163301024502410742C587F8", "data": { "open_url": "sslocal://user/profile/60320267633123456?sec_uid=MS4wLjABAAAAzUKwYoagO3vLvQVSeMxAFUc5INu7rqzoCFmlOYtAtbd9Rah9FpoMg9wpr8QdkdIf" } } (/code) ```
